name: Avernal Flashback
disable: DC 22 Athletics check, DC 22 Occultism check, or DC 22 Religion check; it takes three successful checks to weaken the haunt or erect supports that brace the ceiling. A PC who speaks Dwarven can attempt DC 22 Diplomacy check (trained) checks to calm the phantasmal cave worm.
routine: (2 actions) Zogototaru uses 1 action to create a Tremor. With her other action, she either Exudes Heat or makes Rocks Fall, alternating between the two each round.

items.name: Exude Heat
items.text: Zogototaru breathes fire across Guldrege. Even from a distance, this makes the area blisteringly hot, dealing 3d6 fire damage to all creatures (DC 22 basic Fortitude save save).

items.name: Rocks Fall
items.text: Zogototaru's thrashing appears to crack the roof, dropping debris on a random creature in the area. This deals 4d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 22 basic Reflex save save).

items.name: Tremor
items.text: Zogototaru's thrashing shakes the ground, knocking creatures Prone in the area unless they succeed at a DC 20 Reflex save save.

text: A phantasmal crimson worm appears to rampage outside the workshop, afflicting the area with phantom tremors, blistering heat, and cave-ins.
